children.description: Given the application is open
user opens the browser at https://www.saucedemo.com/
Given the User logs in with username "standard_user" and password "secret_sauce"
user opens the browser at https://www.saucedemo.com/
User iniciar sesion
user enters 'standard_user' into username field
user enters 'secret_sauce' into password field
user clicks on login button
When the User adds the product "Sauce Labs Backpack" to the cart
User agregar producto
user clicks on add button for Sauce Labs Backpack
And the User removes the product "Sauce Labs Backpack" from the cart
user clicks on cart icon
User eliminar producto
user clicks on remove button for Sauce Labs Backpack
user opens the browser at https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html
And the User adds the product "Sauce Labs Bike Light" to the cart
User agregar producto
user clicks on add button for Sauce Labs Bike Light
And the User adds the product "Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt" to the cart
User agregar producto
user clicks on add button for Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt
Then the cart badge should show "2"
When the User continues checkout with first name "John", last name "Doe" and postal code "12345"
user clicks on cart icon
user clicks on checkout button
User diligenciar formulario envio
user enters 'John' into first name field
user enters 'Doe' into last name field
user enters '12345' into postal code field
user clicks on continue button
Then the order subtotal should be greater than "0"
When the User finishes the purchase
user clicks on finish button
Then the order confirmation should contain "Thank you for your order!"
